name: Aegis v3 Hook
mechanic: Surge dynamic fees from a truncated geometric oracle, plus a protocol POL share.
plain: A dynamic-fee hook using a truncated geometric oracle to apply surge fees when the market moves, and taking a protocol-owned-liquidity share of each swap.
rules: Fees surge with market movement, read from a truncated geometric oracle.
A protocol-owned-liquidity share is taken from each swap.
